# Project Context: gate-critique

<!-- Auto-generated by /cortex-spec from spec artifacts. -->
<!-- All agents reference this file for project-level conventions. -->

## Tech Stack

- **Bash / shell** — cortex-critique skill implementation; Codex CLI invocation; `claude -p` fallback
- **Codex CLI** — external tool invoked as `codex exec --full-auto --profile llm --skip-git-repo-check --cd /tmp "<prompt>"`; primary critique engine
- **claude -p** — fallback critique path when `codex` binary is not found (same adversarial prompt, same JSON output schema)
- **SKILL.md files** — skill implementations live in `skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md`; plain-markdown instruction sets
- **JSON** — output schema for Codex critique response: `{ severity, findings[], summary }`
- **`.cortex/state.json`** — machine-readable runtime state; extended with `critique_receipts[]` array

## Conventions

- Skill files: `skills/{skill-name}/SKILL.md` — one skill per directory, invoked by the agent
- Critique artifacts: `docs/cortex/reviews/{slug}/critique-{gate}.md` — one per gate per slug
- Gate receipt format: `critique_receipts[]` array in `.cortex/state.json`
- Artifact paths are always repo-relative
- Phase numbers in skills use the pattern "Phase N" or "Phase Na/Nb" for sub-phases
- Three-tier severity labels: `STOP`, `CAUTION`, `GO` — uppercase only

## Architecture Rules

- **Separate invocation context is required.** The critic must not share conversation history with the generating skill. Codex exec mode satisfies this; `claude -p` subprocess also satisfies it.
- **Adversarial prompt must declare role upfront.** Prompt structure: role declaration → minimum finding requirement → artifact-type dimensions → JSON output schema.
- **AI critique always runs.** It is not gated by autonomy preset. Only the `human_critique` gate is autonomy-conditional.
- **Critique is additive, not replacing.** Critique invocation is inserted before existing gate logic completes; it does not replace any existing gate check.
- **Non-zero exit = CRITIQUE_FAILED warning, not block.** If cortex-critique itself fails, gate proceeds with a warning recorded in `state.json`. Critique failure must not block the pipeline.
- **STOP severity is prominent but not a veto.** AI critique informs; human decides. Hard-blocking based solely on AI critique output is out of scope.

## Write Boundaries

- `skills/cortex-critique/SKILL.md` — new file (create)
- `skills/cortex-clarify/SKILL.md` — edit (Phase 4c addition)
- `skills/cortex-research/SKILL.md` — edit (Phase 2.9 addition)
- `skills/cortex-spec/SKILL.md` — edit (Phase 1c addition)
- `docs/cortex/reviews/{slug}/` — critique artifacts (created per invocation, not part of this contract's write scope directly)
- `.cortex/state.json` — `critique_receipts[]` field addition
